proposed_english: the full one / the whole one
rationale: Greek loanword πλήρης 'full, complete.' Used twice on this page (lines 1, 5) in the medical-therapy register. May refer to the complete dose/prescription, or substantively to a 'completed/full one' (a perfect being). Fits the medical analogy where the wise physician is also 'the full one.'
Lycopolitan reflex of Sahidic ⲡⲁϩⲣⲉ 'medicine, drug, remedy.' Recurs lines 5, 8 in the page's medical metaphor for the teacher's correction of the brother. Standard Coptic medical vocabulary.
Greek loanword θεραπεύω 'serve, attend, heal.' Standard Greek-Coptic medical verb. Used here for the wise teacher's healing-by-correction of the wayward brother.
Coptic ⲥⲁⲉⲓⲛ 'physician, healer' in Lyc. orthography ⲥⲉⲓⲛⲉ. Standard medical-professional term. Functions in line 9 as the figure to whom the wise teacher is likened.

Same lexeme as accumulated 'lust/concupiscence,' but in this kephalaion applied to the divine face of agape. The reduplicated intensive carries 'intense affective longing' — God's longing-for-souls expressed in agape. Preserves the active-affective verbal quality. To be distinguished from the archonic-negative usage.

The second 'face' paired antithetically with ⲁⲅⲁⲧⲏ across lines 16-19. Function is corrective severity that brings to ⲙⲉⲧⲁⲛⲟⲓⲁ 'repentance.' Distinguished from ⲍⲣⲧⲉ 'fear' on the same page. Etymology uncertain — possibly Lyc. ϩⲡⲧⲉ from a striking/urging stem. Confidence low; flagged for parallels.

Greek loanword παιδεύω 'instruct, discipline, train' with elision of initial π- (or ⲁ for ⲡⲁⲓ-). Fits the disciplinary context of the kephalaion. The verb governs how the teacher educates/corrects the brother.
Likely Greek καίπερ 'although' adopted into Coptic. Concessive conjunction introducing the inscrutability of divine judgments.

Compound abstract: ⲙⲛⲧ- + ⲛⲁϣⲧ- ('hard, strict, severe') + ⲙⲏⲉ ('truth'). The state of strict-justice in fraternal correction — the moral quality of righteous severity. Standard Coptic abstract formation.

proposed_english: the watchful teaching / the vigilant instruction
rationale: ⲧⲥⲃⲱ 'the teaching' (per terminology guide) modified by qualitative-relative ⲉⲧⲣⲁⲓ̈ⲥ 'which watches' (= ⲉⲧⲣⲟⲉⲓⲥ). The teaching characterized by alert wakefulness — the disciplinary vigilance proper to elect instruction.
